name: Corann

attributes.attribute: gave a name to a woodland

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Coran is an Irish heroine or goddess. She is not well known. Her name marks a wooded region in the north-west of Ireland. When a wild boar killed some of her hunting dogs, she buried them and raised a mound over them.

okr.objective: Corann is an Irish heroine tied to a woodland and a mound.
key_results: She is an Irish heroine or goddess.
A wooded region bears her name.
She buried her dogs slain by a boar and made a mound.
